finding: Edit and Delete on one sent note share an entry, so the second click does the wrong thing. Edit then Delete queues no delete and the prefilled edit goes out unchanged. Delete then Edit throws a TypeError.
why: entryFor returns any entry with the same key whatever its action, but only a note or edit entry has a textarea. The reviewer rated this medium; the orchestrator read the code and raised it to high under the rubric line 'a real bug on a reachable path'.
fix: On a click of the other action, replace the old entry with a new entry for that action.
evidence: notes.js:121-122 `var found = panel.querySelector('[data-afkv2-item="' + CSS.escape(key) + '"]'); if (found) return found;`. notes.js:235-237 `var entry = entryFor(edit, EDIT); var field = fieldOf(entry); if (!field.value) ...`. A DELETE entry builds no textarea, so fieldOf returns null.

finding: Ingest writes the document first and the settled-round copy second, with no rollback. A failure in the copy write leaves a changed settled round that no longer matches the saved copy, and every later check refuses the document.
why: check_document compares settled rounds byte for byte against the saved copy, so a document and copy that disagree cannot be repaired by the verbs. Not run; inferred from reading.
fix: Write the copy so a failed copy write restores the previous document bytes, or catch OSError in the copy step and raise a Refusal that tells the caller to retry ingest.
evidence: ingest.py:284-286 `inject.write_if_changed(document, ...)` then `if invariants.settled_rounds(doc) != settled_before: save_copy(document, doc)`. engine.py:219-222 catches only Refusal code no-data-folder.

criterion: signature or contract coupling of a split shared function
finding: Possible latent break: `_check_changed` passes the in-memory `doc` as the `raw` argument of `_content_problems`, and ingest then writes that `doc` back over the file.
why: `READERS` exists so a later schema version can return a `doc` that differs from `raw`. Inferred: it holds only once a non-identity reader exists; `read_v0` returns `raw` unchanged today.
fix: Have `cmd_ingest` keep the `raw` from `load_document` and pass it to the changed-document check, or document that ingest supports only identity readers and add a guard.
evidence: engine.py:210 `found = _content_problems(doc, doc)`; engine.py:43-46 `def read_v0(raw: dict) -> dict: return raw`

finding: Possible guard loss: ingest skips the whole settled-round compare and then re-saves the copy, so any unintended edit to a settled round becomes the new baseline.
why: A bug in `apply_response` that alters a settled round would pass silently, and `check_rewrite` never sees it on later runs. Inferred from the code path; D-31 only sanctions saving the copy after a late note.
fix: Compare each settled round before and after ingest, allowing only added notes and responses and state changes on reopen, before `save_copy`.
evidence: engine.py:209 `"""Every check but the settled-round compare: ingest may change a settled round, and saves the copy."""`; ingest.py:285-286

finding: Possible tautology: the test for the notes script's contract with the runtime only checks that attribute names occur as text in notes.js.
why: The test passes when the script never uses an attribute or when runtime.js changes its contract, so it proves no behavior.
fix: Read runtime.js and the page markup in the test and assert that each attribute notes.js writes is one the runtime reads, or run notes.js in a DOM harness.
evidence: def test_the_notes_script_reads_the_attributes_of_the_contract(attribute): assert attribute in NOTES_JS

finding: The only automated test of the AC-041 draft key (session id + round, cleared on send) asserts that a constant copied from notes.js occurs in notes.js.
why: The test echoes the production line. A wrong key or a missing clear on send would still pass.
fix: Execute the draft code against a stub storage. Assert the key for 2 sessions and 2 rounds, and that the storage is empty after the 'Round R-n sent.' status.
evidence: DRAFT_KEY = "'afkv2-draft:' + bar.getAttribute('data-afkv2-session') + ':' + round + ':notes'" (line 32); assert DRAFT_KEY in NOTES_JS; assert "' sent.'" in NOTES_JS

finding: After the rewrite, the slot test no longer shows that the slot draws the registered component, which D-54 requires.
why: The real component is always registered, so the test passes if the slot calls render_notes_replies directly. The 'no component registered gives an empty slot' branch at shell/page.py:82 also has no test now.
fix: Replace the registry entry for the test with a stub using monkeypatch.setitem(registry._types, ...). Assert that the slot holds the stub output, and an empty slot when the entry is removed.
evidence: drawn = registry.lookup("notes-and-replies").render({"document": doc}, []); assert holds(page.build(doc), f'id="afkv2-notes-replies">{drawn}</section>')

finding: Possible weak steer-home test: the linked-card and node-holder preferences cannot be told apart from the current-round order in any test.
why: In each steer test the linked or holding card is also the first card of the current round, so removing `*linked, *holder` from the candidate list leaves every test green.
fix: Add a case where the linked card, and one where the holding card, comes after a free card in the current round. Assert that the steer lands on the linked or holding card.
evidence: afkv2/engine/ingest.py:164 candidates = [*linked, *holder, *page.current["items"], *newest_first]

finding: No test edits or deletes a note whose target is a steer (a map node, or the map).
why: The second-pass edit branch and the steer case of the delete branch run only for steer notes, and all edit and delete tests use notes whose target is an ordinary card.
fix: Add tests that send `<note id> edit | text` and `<note id> delete` for a note whose target is a map node. Assert the text, the `deleted` flag and the `steer` signal.
evidence: ingest.py:239-242 `if line.token == EDIT: item, note = page.notes[line.target]; signals[...] = {... "steer": True, "action": EDIT}`

finding: No test makes the check after the change (`check_changed`) refuse, so the guarantee that ingest writes only a valid document has no failing test.
why: All 'invariant' refusals in the tests come from the check before the change. Deleting line 282 leaves every test green.
fix: Add a case where the applied response breaks an invariant. Assert exit 1 with code `invariant` and an unchanged file.
evidence: ingest.py:282 `check_changed(doc)`; tests with code "invariant" both fail in `check(args.document)`

finding: No test sends an option letter that the debate card does not offer, or any mark on an info card.
why: These are the off-boundary cases of the new `accepts` comparisons. Changing `token in _options(item)` to `True` leaves the tests green.
fix: Add refusal cases to the grammar parametrization: `i-a z` on a debate card with only options a and b, and `i-a accept` on an info card.
evidence: ingest.py:98-99 `if item["kind"] == "debate" and LETTER.fullmatch(token): return token in _options(item)`; test_ingest.py:244 uses only ("debate", "a")

criterion: Acceptance: live browser test (AC-042) and seam-test row 'lavish host'
finding: The Result table of the live test has no row. The file holds no record of a pass, the commit tested, the layout audit, or the lavish-axi version.
why: The seam-test row requires the live test on lavish-axi 0.1.80. The run evidence is only a journal line.

evidence: ## Result | Date | Commit | Result | Layout audit | (end of file; no row follows)

finding: The diff edits .claude/wiring-ious.md, which matches no glob in the 0005 `## Scope`.
why: The path is outside the declared lane. The edit has a ledger anchor (D-48, which says the IOU row closes on this work), and the same file was edited in earlier slices, but the contract does not list it.
fix: Add the path to the 0005 `## Scope`, or record an orchestrator ruling like D-54 for this one-line close.
evidence: D-48: `Review finding f001 and the open row in `.claude/wiring-ious.md` close on this work`

criterion: Acceptance: live browser test (Playwright MCP + Edge)
finding: The acceptance bullet and the Verification row name Playwright MCP. The slice drives Edge through a raw DevTools-protocol Node driver (D-53). The contract text was not amended.
why: The change is recorded as a decision, not silent, but the contract and PRD line 248 still name a method the slice does not use.
fix: Amend the contract bullet and the Verification row to name the DevTools driver, or note D-53 beside them.
evidence: contract line 43: "- [ ] Live browser test (Playwright MCP + Edge) ..."; DECISIONS.md D-53

criterion: Acceptance: a note on a settled item reopens it, and the reopen is recorded in the next round (SDD section 6, AC-038)
finding: A reopen is written into the signals of the current round only. For a settled card of the current round the reopen is not recorded in the next round. The carry of the card to the next round is left to a caller.
why: SDD section 6 and the contract bullet say the reopen is recorded in the next round. D-51 hands the second half to a caller. The reviewer did not find or check a consumer that does it.
fix: Name the caller that carries the reopened card into the next round, as an IOU or contract line, or state in the contract that the signals of the current round are the record.
evidence: DECISIONS.md D-51: "A reopen is in the signals of the current round, and the caller carries the card to the next round."

criterion: Acceptance: a mark and a note that disagree, or 2 marks that disagree, keep the point open (AC-037)
finding: For an open or blocked point, conflicting signals go to needs_reading, not open. The contract bullet and PRD AC-037 say 'stays open'. Only a settled point goes to open.
why: The result follows the SDD section 6 state diagram and decision D-51, so it is a recorded interpretation. The contract bullet is met literally only for settled points.
fix: Reword the contract bullet and AC-037 to 'stays unsettled', or confirm D-51 with the owner.
evidence: ingest.py:57 `return "settled_by_mark" if lone else "needs_reading"`; PRD AC-037: "stays open"

criterion: Acceptance: a note on a map node is recorded as a steer for that node (AC-038)
finding: When no item has a free note for the round, a steer is folded into a card note, and the stored note target becomes the item id. No test shows that a folded second note moves the target (D-50).
why: Only the response signal keeps the node id and the steer flag, and the rendered notes slot shows 'Note on <item>'. In both fold tests the first note already has the item id as target. D-50 records the fold and the case is rare.
fix: Keep the node id in the folded text, or refuse the fold and tell the caller. Fold a steer into a note with a part or node target in a test.
evidence: ingest.py:145-147 `if note["target"] != target: note["target"] = item["id"]`

finding: The test that long text wraps checks only that 2 CSS strings occur in notes.css.
why: It does not show that the rules apply to the right selectors, or that text wraps in a browser.

finding: The last assertion of the map-in-a-label test is always true, and the `capsys` argument is unused.

finding: The test of 'the agent returns an unclear point to open' sets the state by hand and then checks the fixture it just built.
why: It proves that the check accepts `open`, not that any code returns a conflict to open.

finding: 4 driver steps pass a constant `true`, so the step line records a pass whatever happened.
why: The only guard is an exception thrown inside click or type. The step names suggest a checked result.

evidence: step('note on a card', true); step('note and reopen on settled items', true); step('note on a diagram and a freestyle fragment', true);

finding: No test covers the branch where the data folder is missing and ingest skips saving the settled copy without a message.
why: The tests always set LOCALAPPDATA through the `path` fixture, so the silent skip, and what the next check says, has no assertion.
fix: Add a test with no data folder. Assert that ingest answers ok, and that a later check reports the copy as unavailable.
evidence: engine.py:217-222 `_save_settled_copy_if_possible ... if refusal.code != "no-data-folder": raise`
